# Translation glossary

<!-- Generated by scripts/i18n-glossary.mjs from glossary.json. Edit glossary.json, then run `node scripts/i18n-glossary.mjs --write`. -->

Every locale uses the approved rendering below for each product term, in every message and on every page.
Write each translation from the full English message; the glossary fixes terminology, not sentence structure.
`src/i18n/glossary.test.ts` fails when a translation drops an approved term, uses a listed variant, breaks
the locale register, or exceeds the display-width budget recorded in `usage-notes.json`.

## Workflow

1. Look up the message in `usage-notes.json`: its page, element kind (button, table header, label, heading, body…) and `maxWidth`.
2. Translate the whole message with the approved terms below. Buttons and table headers must stay within `maxWidth`
   display columns (East Asian wide characters count as two).
3. Run `npx vitest run src/i18n/glossary.test.ts`. When a fix clears a recorded violation, regenerate the baseline with
   `I18N_BASELINE=update npx vitest run src/i18n/glossary.test.ts`. The baseline may only shrink.
4. `node scripts/i18n-glossary.mjs --report <page>` lists the remaining recorded violations for one page.

Identifiers (`context=`, `vram`, `owner/repository`), commands, units and publisher names stay in English. Messages whose
English uses a word in an unrelated sense are listed under each term’s exceptions in `glossary.json`.

## Register

| Locale | Register |
| --- | --- |
| zh-TW | Address the reader as 你, never 您. Use Taiwan terminology and full-width punctuation around Chinese text. |
| zh-CN | Address the reader as 你, never 您. Use mainland terminology. |
| ja | Polite です/ます style for sentences; noun phrases for buttons and labels. |
| ko | Polite 합니다/하세요 style; noun phrases for buttons and labels. |
| es | Address the reader as usted (su, sus, verifique). Never tú. |
| pt | Brazilian Portuguese with você. |
| fr | Address the reader as vous. Use a non-breaking space before : ; ? ! |
| de | Address the reader as Sie. Buttons use the infinitive ("Datei verwenden"), not an imperative sentence. |
| ru | Address the reader as вы (lowercase in running text). Buttons use the infinitive. |
| ar | Modern Standard Arabic, second person singular imperative for instructions. |
| hi | आप register. Common English technical terms are transliterated (मेमोरी, कॉन्टेक्स्ट, टोकन). |
| id | Formal Anda register. |

## Meaning and variants to avoid

### VRAM

Dedicated GPU memory, or the memory budget a user enters.

Avoid: zh-TW `顯示記憶體|顯存|视频内存`; zh-CN `VRAM|视频内存`; ja `ビデオメモリ`; ko `비디오 메모리`; ru `видеопамят`.

### KV cache

Attention key/value cache that grows with context length.

Avoid: zh-TW `緩存|缓存`; zh-CN `快取`; es `\bcache\b`; ru `кеш`.

### quantization

Reducing weight precision (GGUF, MLX, EXL2 and similar formats).

Avoid: fr `quantization|quantisation`; de `quantifizier`; hi `परिमाणीकरण`.

### context

The LLM context window measured in tokens. Not the general sense of 'situation'.

Avoid: zh-TW `語境|脈絡|情境`; zh-CN `语境`; ja `文脈`; ko `맥락|문맥`; hi `संदर्भ`.

### capacity

Total memory available on a device (VRAM capacity, usable capacity).

Avoid: ru `[её]мкост`.

### verified / unverified

Evidence status label: checked against a primary source or a measurement. Ordinary prose such as 'not independently verified' is not checked.

Avoid: zh-TW `核實`; zh-CN `核实`; ru `подтвержд`.

### derived

Evidence status label: calculated from verified facts rather than published directly. The verb ('is derived from') is ordinary prose and is not checked.

Avoid: zh-TW `推導所得|衍生`; zh-CN `推导出|衍生`; ja `派生`; ko `파생`; ru `производн`.

### weights

Model parameters stored in memory. Not the sense of physical weight.

### runtime

Three senses share one word family: the inference software (llama.cpp, vLLM), the Runtime buffer row in the memory breakdown, and the adjective 'at run time' (runtime memory). Use the approved noun for the first two; the adjective may use the locale's natural 'at execution time' form.

Avoid: zh-TW `運行時|运行时`.

### offload

Moving layers or cache out of VRAM into system RAM when the model does not fit. llama.cpp's "GPU offload" (moving layers onto the GPU) is the opposite direction and is an exception.

### estimate

A calculated memory figure. Always an estimate, never a guarantee.

Avoid: zh-TW `估計值`; ja `推定`.

### artifact

A published, downloadable model file set (a GGUF file, an MLX folder, a quantized repository). In running prose 'model file' is acceptable where it reads more naturally.

Avoid: ar `قطعة أثرية|قطع أثرية`.

### repository

A Hugging Face model repository (owner/name).

Avoid: zh-TW `倉庫|存放庫|仓库`; zh-CN `存储库|儲存庫`; ko `리포지토리|레포지토리`; fr `référentiel`.

### precision

Numeric format of weights or KV cache (FP16, Q8_0, 4-bit).

Avoid: hi `परिशुद्धता`.

### parameters

Model parameter count (8B, 70B). API query parameters are listed as exceptions.

Avoid: ko `매개변수`; ar `معلمات|المعلمات`.

### token

A unit of model text. Hugging Face access tokens use the same word.

Avoid: zh-TW `詞元|標記|令牌`; zh-CN `词元`; fr `jeton`.

### lower bound

The estimate is a minimum; real usage can be higher.

### publisher

The Hugging Face account that published a model or quantization (Unsloth, bartowski).

Avoid: zh-TW `發行者|出版者|發佈者`; ja `公開者`; es `\beditor`; hi `प्रकाशक`.

### community

Third-party quantizations published by community accounts. Publisher names such as mlx-community and LM Studio Community stay unchanged.

Avoid: zh-TW `社區`; hi `समुदाय`.

### memory

RAM or VRAM in general. zh-CN uses 显存 when the sentence is specifically about GPU memory.

### evidence

The facts and sources behind an estimate or a troubleshooting answer (Estimate evidence, evidence questions).

Avoid: zh-TW `證據`; zh-CN `依据`; ja `証拠`; es `\bpruebas?\b`; fr `justificatif`; de `\bbeleg`; hi `प्रमाण`.

### engine

Inference software (llama.cpp, vLLM, MLX LM).

Avoid: pt `\bmotor`; id `\bmesin`.

### runbook

The step-by-step deployment document generated on /deploy.

Avoid: zh-TW `操作指南`; ja `手順書`; es `\bguía`; ru `инструкци`.

### draft model

The small model in speculative decoding (DFlash, EAGLE).

Avoid: ko `초안`; fr `brouillon`.
